title: Works of Literature/art/films inspired by Mall World/the Astral/Orion
content: I sincerely believe that so many works of art were inspired by mall world and we see echoes of it throughout pop culture. This is true not only about places in the mall world realm, but also the higher astral realm directly above mall world, what I like to call “Orion”, a peaceful Neverland-like place where creativity and inspiration is nurtured. Here are some works that I feel like came from mall world through either conscious or subconscious dream visits the authors have. This is not to say I think all of these are well written or completely copied exactly — but I definitely see strong resemblance to places we’ve all come to be familiar with. - Picnic at Hanging Rock (novel)- the author even said she was inspired by an unsettling dream of this place when she was 4 years old (a common age when all of us can easily ascend to the higher astral realms). - Peter Pan - there’s so much astral travel in this obviously. Peter Pan is a spirit guide. Never land is Orion. “Getting older” means forgetting how to astral travel and losing easy access to the higher astral realms. - Alice in Wonderland - 1000% mall world coded, very unsettling vibes, constantly falling / looking for a way out. Cheshire Cat is a spirit guide. The entities try their hardest to trap Alice’s astral body in the realm because they are feeding on her energy/sense of self (she is constantly mis-named — causing confusion and erosion of her identity — untethering her further from the physical plane — she eventually escapes by mastering lucidity ). - the Shining. 1000% the hotel in mall world. - Harry Potter - school is mall world coded, down to the moving staircases and the forbidden forest and definitely the room of requirements really exists. - Phantasma - haunted house game/trials, parts are definitely mall world coded. The Girl in the Castle Inside the Museum - look up the premise to this one and tell me it isn’t mall world. Madeleine is Sleeping - absurdist french mall world coded fever dream. - Piranesi - obviously - The Starless Sea - duh - Caraval - mhm - The Child Thief by Brom - Music/ ballet by Tchaikovsky, specifically Swan Lake and The Nutcracker - both definitely Orion / mall world coded - Avatar - Pangaea is Orion / higher astral realm coded - Narnia - specifically the lion the witch and the wardrobe - all are mall world coded, especially in regards to the war going on and the ice queen. There’s an evil queen (one of several powerful entities) that influences a lot of things throughout mall world and the lower astral. - The Golden Compass - especially in regards to using the aurora borealis as a portal into another world that is a ghostly post apocalyptic city. And evil lower entities and the humans manipulated by them trying to separate children from their daemons / astral bodies / soul guides. ALSO, the lab setting where they experimented on kids. - Anastasia (cartoon film) - especially the ruined ballroom scene. - The Wizard of Oz - especially the tornado as a portal. Dorothy eventually escapes by gaining lucidity. - Ghibli films, ESPECIALLY Spirited Away (the spirit brothel, the witch, working as an employee there, THE TRAIN and so much more) and My Neighbor Totoro (higher astral realm coded/ spirit guides). Princess Mononoke as well. - Disney parks are explicitly based off mall world. - the magicians trilogy, not just the magical school but ESPECIALLY when they get into the other realm — particularly the library and the different fountains in the empty city. And Put Away Childish Things by Adrian Tchaikovsky — ESPECIALLY the cannibalistic nature of the other world and how it feeds off humans energies Art by Salvador Dali Films by Guillermo del toro Kingdom Hearts franchise - ESPECIALLY Destiny Island, Traverse Town, the beginning towns in kh2&3, Mickey’s castle, the castle in chain of memories more so, the entire intro (painted mosaics floating in darkness, winding staircases, SHADOW MONSTER, doors to other worlds being sealed/broken, Organization 13, ESPECIALLY Namine, who I strongly believe was lifted directly from the astral realm, name/aesthetic/general job description as a witch / keeper of memories included. She is a spirit guide. Final Fantasy, especially X and X2—- ESPECIALLY zanarkind, sin as a tsunami, the spirit guides (forget their names), the Zanarkind ruins, the marriage of Seymour and Yuna, the huge concert at the beginning of X2. Inception (movie) - dream within a dream, mastering lucidity, dreams as weapons/manipulation Stranger Things — all of it, they even have a mall scene. Insidious franchise — all of movie 1-2, specifically references astral travel, entities that feed off human souls, kids being more attuned to the astral, forgetting as a defense mechanism as we get older but can still remember how, it’s like a muscle, it takes practice, some are more attuned than others Dungeon crawler Carl — DEFINITELY inspired by mall world, the different floors = astral planes, the lower you go the crazier they get, one floor there’s literally faction wars going on and another floor is Hell. Another one is ALL TRAINS AND SUBWAY STATIONS. Another is medieval. There are bars / hidden restaurants from our world interspersed and weird bathrooms. The concept of waking up the enslaved employees of the game who dont know that they’re being manipulated by the AI and have had false memories implanted so they can act as plot devices in the arcs of scripted story lines.
